title: Battle of Gedaref
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Gedaref", at revision 1370441384, opens: "The Battle of Gedaref was fought on 22 October 1898 to relieve the besieged British garrison at Gedaref." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2888593, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1898 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
